networkPolicy.desc: Navigation works; place photos and Street View do not

notes: Every host is written out, and that is the whole point of this file. Upstream blocks "*.googleusercontent.com", which reads as a wildcard and is not one: in this data format the star is dropped and a www twin added, so it expands to googleusercontent.com and www.googleusercontent.com and matches nothing that serves a photograph. Place photos come from lh3 through lh6, so a policy that means to block them has to say so. See KDroidHosts in the application for the evidence.
